integrations.rotate.confirmBody: A new version with a new secret is issued after version {{version}}. The secret is shown once. Older versions that are still active stop working when the rotation overlap period ends.
integrations.rotate.failed: The API key could not be rotated.
integrations.rotate.conflictTitle: This API key has already been rotated by someone else.
integrations.rotate.conflictBody: Nothing was changed. The list has been refreshed: check the latest version before rotating again.
integrations.rotate.unknownBody: It was not retried automatically. If the new version was stored, its secret can never be shown again. Check the list below: if a version appeared that you did not get the secret for, rotate again or revoke that version.

integrations.secret.warning: This secret is shown only once. After you close this dialog it cannot be viewed again. Copy it and store it safely now.
integrations.secret.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the secret and copy it by hand.
integrations.secret.close: I have saved the secret, close
integrations.revoke.keyTitle: Revoke every version of this API key?
integrations.revoke.versionWarning: Revoking is permanent. This version stops working immediately and can never be made active again.
integrations.revoke.keyWarning: Revoking is permanent. Every active version of this key stops working immediately and can never be made active again.

webhookSigning.loadFailed: The webhook signing secrets could not be loaded.
webhookSigning.empty: This project has no webhook signing secrets yet.
webhookSigning.emptyPage: There are no signing versions on this page.
webhookSigning.error.pendingExists: This project already has a pending version. Activate or retire it before issuing another one.
webhookSigning.error.notPending: This version has been retired and can no longer be activated.
webhookSigning.error.encryptionNotConfig: Encryption is not configured on the server, so no signing secret can be issued.
webhookSigning.error.listRefreshed: Nothing was changed. The list has been refreshed.
webhookSigning.issue.confirmTitle: Issue a new webhook signing secret?
webhookSigning.issue.confirmBody: A new pending version is created. The platform does not sign with it until you activate it. Its secret is shown only once.
webhookSigning.issue.failed: The signing secret could not be issued.
webhookSigning.issue.unknownTitle: We could not confirm whether a new signing secret was issued.
webhookSigning.issue.unknownBody: It was not retried automatically. Check the list below: if a pending version appeared that you did not get the secret for, its secret can never be shown again. Retire that pending version and issue another one.
webhookSigning.activate.retiresActive: Version {{active}} is active now. It is retired at the same moment, and the platform signs with version {{version}} from then on.
webhookSigning.activate.retiresAnyActive: The version that is active now, if any, is retired at the same moment, and the platform signs with this version from then on.
webhookSigning.activate.integrationReady: Activate only after the integration has been configured to accept both the old and the new version. Otherwise its webhooks fail signature verification.
webhookSigning.activate.failed: The version could not be activated.
webhookSigning.retire.warning: Retiring is permanent. The platform never signs with this version again.
webhookSigning.retire.activeWarning: This is the active version. After retiring it the project has no signing secret, and webhooks wait until a new version is activated.
webhookSigning.retire.reasonHint: Write only the business reason. Do not include personal data such as names, phone numbers or email addresses. The reason is kept in the audit log.
webhookSigning.retire.reasonTooLong: The reason can be at most 255 characters.
webhookSigning.secret.title: New webhook signing secret
webhookSigning.secret.warning: This secret is shown only once. After you close this dialog it cannot be viewed again. Copy it and store it safely now.
webhookSigning.secret.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the secret and copy it by hand.
webhookSigning.secret.close: I have saved the secret, close
webhookSigning.secret.nextStep: Give the secret to the integration and have it accept both the old and the new version, then activate this version.
wallet.adjustment.title: Manual wallet adjustment
wallet.adjustment.amountHint: Enter the amount without a sign. Credit types add it to the balance; debit types take it away.
wallet.adjustment.amountInvalid: Enter digits only: up to 12 before the decimal point and up to 8 after it, with no sign or exponent.
wallet.adjustment.reasonHint: Write only the business reason. Do not include personal data such as names, phone numbers or email addresses. The reason is kept permanently and can never be changed.
wallet.adjustment.reasonTooLong: The reason can be at most 255 characters.
wallet.adjustment.unknownTitle: We could not confirm whether the adjustment was posted.
wallet.adjustment.unknownBody: It may already be on the ledger. Retry with the same key: if it was posted, the retry will not post it again. The type, amount and reason are now locked. To post something different, close this form and check the balance first.
wallet.adjustment.conflictTitle: This adjustment conflicts with one already posted under the same key.
wallet.adjustment.conflictBody: Nothing was posted. Close this form and check the balance before starting again.
wallet.adjustment.replayed: This adjustment had already been posted earlier. It was not posted again.
wallet.adjustment.replayedNote: The amount and balance below are the ones recorded when it was first posted.

catalog.providers.title: AI providers
catalog.providers.intro: Provider and model codes are matched exactly against the provider and model that applications report with their usage.

catalog.providers.codeHint: Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores, for example anthropic. It must equal the provider value that applications report.
catalog.providers.codeInvalid: Use 1–64 lowercase letters, digits, hyphens or underscores, starting with a letter or digit.
catalog.meterTypes.title: Meter types
catalog.meterTypes.intro: A meter type is the usage_type that applications report. Each component is priced separately and takes its quantity from one field of the usage event.
catalog.meterTypes.loadFailed: The meter types could not be loaded.
catalog.meterTypes.emptyFiltered: No meter types have this status.
catalog.meterTypes.emptyPage: There are no meter types on this page.
catalog.meterTypes.codeHint: Uppercase, for example VIDEO_SECOND. Applications report it as usage_type.
catalog.meterTypes.codeInvalid: Use 2–32 uppercase letters, digits or underscores, starting with a letter.
catalog.meterTypes.unitHint: Uppercase, for example SECOND. Reported usage must use exactly this unit.
catalog.meterTypes.unitInvalid: Use 1–16 uppercase letters, digits or underscores, starting with a letter.
catalog.meterTypes.quantityKindHint: Whether reported quantities are whole numbers or may have decimals.
catalog.meterTypes.componentCodeHint: The code that prices are attached to. No other meter type may use it; it is often the same as the code.
catalog.meterTypes.quantityOnly: New meter types always use the QUANTITY shape.
catalog.meterTypes.multiFieldNeedsCode: Usage is reported with usage_type, quantity and unit, and the single component takes its quantity from quantity. A shape with several quantity fields, like LLM_TOKEN, needs a code change and cannot be created here.
catalog.meterTypes.createFailed: The meter type was not created.
catalog.meterTypes.permanent: The code, unit, quantity kind and component code cannot be changed after the meter type is created.
catalog.detail.loadFailed: The provider could not be loaded.

catalog.aliases.explanation: Usage that already happened keeps the model it was matched to. The one exception is a string that has never been mapped before: its first mapping also covers earlier usage, which so far matched no model and was not charged.
catalog.aliases.aliasHint: The model string exactly as applications report it, including letter case, for example claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929.
catalog.aliases.retireBody: From now on, usage reported with this string matches no model: it is kept as MODEL_UNKNOWN and not charged until the string is mapped again. Earlier usage keeps the model it was matched to.

pricing.create.draftNote: A draft does not affect billing until it is published.
pricing.edit.title: Edit draft
pricing.edit.newComponents: New components (they replace all current ones)
pricing.edit.confirmTitle: Save the changes to this draft?
pricing.publish.title: Publish
pricing.publish.atInvalid: Enter a complete, real date and time.
pricing.publish.nowBody: It takes effect from the next whole second, and the version in effect until then ends at that moment. Usage that already happened keeps the price or rate it had.
pricing.publish.scheduledBody: It takes effect at the scheduled time, which cannot be in the past. The version in effect until then ends at that moment.
pricing.retire.title: Retire
pricing.retire.priceBody: If this version is already in effect, usage from now on has no price from it until another version is published. If it is scheduled and has not started, the schedule is withdrawn. Usage that already happened keeps its price.
pricing.retire.reasonHint: Write only the business reason. It is kept in the audit log.
pricing.retire.reasonTooLong: The reason can be at most 255 characters.
pricing.discard.title: Discard this draft?
pricing.discard.body: The draft is kept for the record but can no longer be edited or published.

pricing.detail.notFoundBody: No price version has this ID. The link may be mistyped or out of date.
pricing.rules.title: Pricing rules
pricing.rules.intro: A pricing rule decides what a customer is charged. At any moment the most specific rule in effect applies: customer, provider and model; then customer and provider; then customer; then provider and model for all customers; then the global default. This list is the full price history.
pricing.rules.taxNote: Rule prices are in MYR and include tax. Markups and rates are shown to administrators only.
pricing.rules.forbidden: Only administrators can manage pricing rules and preview charges.
pricing.rules.loadFailed: The pricing rules could not be loaded.
pricing.rules.emptyFiltered: No pricing rules match these filters.
pricing.rules.emptyPage: There are no pricing rules on this page.
pricing.rules.form.lookupFailed: The customers, providers, models or meter types could not be loaded.
pricing.rules.form.scopeHint: Choose the scope first: only the fields it needs are shown. The scope cannot be changed after the draft is created.
pricing.rules.form.multiplierHint: Multiplies the estimated provider cost in MYR. The result is the tax-inclusive amount charged to the customer.
pricing.rules.form.multiplierInvalid: Enter a positive number with up to 12 digits before the decimal point and up to 8 after it, with no sign or exponent.
pricing.rules.create.title: New pricing rule draft
pricing.rules.error.notFound: This pricing rule does not exist.
pricing.rules.error.meterTypeNotFound: This usage type is not in the catalog.
pricing.rules.error.notDraft: This rule has already been published, so it can no longer be edited or discarded.
pricing.rules.error.incomplete: This fixed-rate draft is incomplete: every component of each meter type it uses needs a rate.
pricing.rules.error.notRetirable: Only the latest published rule of a scope can be disabled. Drafts are discarded instead.
pricing.rules.error.final: This rule has been disabled or discarded and cannot be changed.
pricing.rules.error.effectiveFromConflic: The time does not fit the existing rules of this scope. If a scheduled rule has not started yet, choose a later time or disable that rule first.
pricing.rules.error.amountOutOfRange: One of the calculated amounts is too large to be stored.
pricing.rules.detail.loadFailed: The pricing rule could not be loaded.
pricing.rules.detail.notFoundBody: No pricing rule has this ID. The link may be mistyped or out of date.
pricing.rules.detail.noComponents: This rule has no components yet.
pricing.rules.edit.title: Edit pricing rule draft
pricing.rules.publish.nowBody: It takes effect from the next whole second, and the rule of this scope in effect until then ends at that moment. Only the very first global default applies from the beginning. Usage that already happened keeps the rule it had.
pricing.rules.publish.scheduledBody: It takes effect at the scheduled time, which cannot be in the past. The rule of this scope in effect until then ends at that moment.
pricing.rules.retire.title: Disable pricing rule
pricing.rules.retire.body: If this rule is already in effect, from now on usage in its scope falls through to the next lower scope, or has no rule and is not charged. If it is scheduled and has not started, the schedule is withdrawn. Usage that already happened keeps its price.
pricing.preview.title: Pricing preview
pricing.preview.intro: Calculates what one usage event would cost at the time you enter, with the same code that bills real usage. Only published prices, exchange rates and rules are used. Nothing is saved.
pricing.preview.estimateNote: Estimated cost, not visible to customers.
pricing.preview.form.modelHint: The model code or an alias, exactly as applications report it.
pricing.preview.form.integerQuantityHint: Enter a whole number with up to 12 digits.
pricing.preview.form.decimalQuantityHint: Enter a number with up to 12 digits before the decimal point and up to 8 after it, with no sign or exponent.
pricing.preview.form.unitHint: Always the unit of the chosen usage type.
pricing.preview.form.occurredAtHint: When the usage happened. It may be in the future, to preview scheduled prices and rules.
pricing.preview.form.tokensInvalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 1,000,000,000,000.
pricing.preview.failed: The preview could not be calculated.
pricing.preview.explain.modelUnknown: The provider and model matched no model in the catalog at this time.
pricing.preview.explain.fxRateError: No exchange rate for the source currency was in effect at this time.
pricing.preview.explain.noProviderPrice: No provider price was in effect for this model at this time.
pricing.preview.explain.missingProviderC: The provider price in effect has no price for one of this usage type's components.
pricing.preview.explain.noPricingRule: No pricing rule applied to this customer, provider and model at this time.
pricing.preview.explain.missingRuleCompo: The rule that applies is a fixed rate without a rate for one of this usage type's components. Lower-level rules are not used instead.
pricing.preview.fxNotNeeded: Not needed: the source currency is MYR.
pricing.preview.amount.name: Amount
pricing.preview.result.title: Result
pricing.preview.result.amountsNote: Each stored value is its unrounded value rounded half up once, to 8 decimal places. The MYR estimate times the markup may differ from the customer charge in the last digit.
fx.title: Exchange rates
fx.note: Middle rate, Kuala Lumpur noon session, effective from the moment it is published.
fx.rateMeaning: Each rate is how many MYR one unit of the currency is worth. BNM fetches only ever create drafts; an administrator publishes them here.
fx.loadFailed: The exchange rates could not be loaded.
fx.emptyPage: There are no exchange rates on this page.
fx.form.currencyHint: Three capital letters, for example USD. It cannot be MYR and cannot be changed later.
fx.form.currencyInvalid: Enter three capital letters other than MYR.
fx.form.rateHint: How many MYR one unit of the currency is worth, with up to 10 decimal places.
fx.form.rateInvalid: Enter a positive number with up to 14 digits before the decimal point and up to 10 after it, with no sign or exponent.
fx.form.referenceHint: Where the rate comes from, for example a bank notice and the date it was viewed.
fx.retireBody: If this rate is already in effect, the currency has no exchange rate from now on until another version is published. If it is scheduled and has not started, the schedule is withdrawn. Usage that already happened keeps its rate.
fx.attempts.title: BNM fetch attempts
fx.attempts.note: Each automatic fetch of the BNM middle rate. A new quote becomes a draft here; nothing is published automatically.
fx.attempts.loadFailed: The fetch attempts could not be loaded.
fx.attempts.emptyPage: There are no fetch attempts on this page.

usage.detail.noConflicts: No conflicting requests for this event ID.
usage.error.notFound: This usage event does not exist.
usage.error.customerNotFound: The customer in the filters does not exist.
usage.error.notRequeuable: This event cannot be requeued: it is not in an error status, or it already has a ledger entry.
usage.error.validation: The request was not accepted. Check the filters or the reason.
usage.requeue.title: Requeue this event
usage.requeue.failed: The events could not be requeued.
usage.requeue.done: Requeued. The event will be billed in the next sweep.
usage.requeue.reasonHint: Recorded in the audit log, for example what was fixed.
usage.requeue.reasonTooLong: Keep the reason to 255 characters or fewer.
usage.requeue.body: Requeued events go back to Received and are billed again in the next sweep (about every 10 seconds). Only events that never affected a wallet are changed.
usage.selected.title: Requeue the selected events
usage.selected.body: {{selected}} selected events in an error status. Any that were requeued or processed in the meantime are skipped.
usage.bulk.unavailable: To requeue everything that matches, filter by one error status and not by project, conversation or request.
usage.bulk.title: Requeue all matching events
usage.bulk.count: Up to {{events}} events will be requeued (at most {{limit}} per run).
usage.bulk.body: Events are taken in the order they were received. Events with a ledger entry, or whose status changed in the meantime, are skipped. Run it again for more than the limit.
